test_record_management_and_sd_card_statu.title: Verify recording management and SD card status

steps.expected: The RECORD MANAGEMENT page opens and the Target stream list offers None, Main stream and Sub stream.
Two recorded devices per SD card slot of the model are listed (RECORD0 and RECORD1 on one slot, RECORD0 to RECORD7 on four), each with File type MP4 and its own slot's card as Storage.

steps.action: Open RECORD > STORAGE and read the Storage list.
steps.expected: Every SD card slot of the model is listed as mounted, with a size, a used percentage between 0 and 100, and an available space no larger than the size.
